target.title: Allow alternate Zalo Bot API roots
target.body:
## Summary

- allow the Zalo Bot API client to use a primitive alternate API root through `ZALO_API_URL`
- preserve explicit `apiUrl` option precedence and the existing production endpoint by default
- reject blank, malformed, non-HTTP(S), query-bearing, and fragment-bearing roots
- block the exact `ZALO_API_URL` key from untrusted workspace dotenv files while allowing trusted process/global dotenv input
- align `getMe` bot identity with the native `id`, `account_name`, `account_type`, and `can_join_groups` fields
- normalize inbound Zalo timestamps by preserving the provider's documented epoch-millisecond values and converting legacy epoch-second payloads once

This is a general provider endpoint and compatibility seam. It adds no QA-specific code, no Crabline imports or naming, and no channel config schema.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run extensions/zalo/src/api.test.ts extensions/zalo/src/monitor.image.polling.test.ts src/infra/dotenv.test.ts` (52 tests)
- `pnpm tsgo:test:extensions`
- type-aware `oxlint` on all changed production and test files
- local HTTP roundtrip through the real Zalo `getMe`, `getUpdates`, and `sendMessage` client paths against a provider-shaped server
- final autoreview clean for identity propagation, timestamp normalization, endpoint/env behavior, and dotenv guarding

`pnpm check:changed` passed its conflict, attribution, export, duplication, dependency, and core production typecheck gates, but the delegated test run currently fails on two unrelated `src/commands/daemon-install-helpers.test.ts` fixture type errors also present on current `main` (lines 487 and 1281). Run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28548582454
